scheme_name: Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Sinking Tubewell
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian National
Applicant must be native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or have continuous residence for the past 5 years
Applicant must obtain the mandatory permit from Pondicherry Ground Water Authority for constructing a new or replacement tubewell/filter point

Tubewell must be constructed using departmental power rig/hand bore set or, if using private machinery, must have a No Objection Certificate (NOC) and the machinery must be registered with Pondicherry Ground Water Authority under departmental supervision
Applicant must hold a minimum of 1.5 acres of land in the command area of the tubewell/filter point
Applicant must have ownership of the land for at least 2 years and possess a clear ownership title deed in his/her name
The eligible land holding of 1.5 acres can be in the name of the applicant, spouse, or a member of the joint/undivided family
Farmers who have availed subsidy for the same purpose within the last 5 years are not eligible
Casing pipes must have a BIS certificate and be purchased from an authorized dealer or M/s. PASIC Ltd
Applicant must not convert the land for a minimum period of 10 years from the date of construction and must execute a bond accordingly
benefits_summary: 90% subsidy up to ₹1,80,000 per tubewell/filter point for eligible Scheduled Caste farmers.
documents_required: Permit from Pondicherry Ground Water Authority
